info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Streaming Subscriptions API allows users to manage and delete active streaming subscriptions efficiently. This endpoint is essential for consumers looking to halt their subscription services and ensure that they are not billed for future cycles. By providing the ability to cancel subscriptions, the API supports various use cases, such as user account management and cost control. This API is particularly useful for developers integrating subscription management features in applications that involve streaming services.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel an existing subscription. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing subscription. Clients must provide the required information in the JSON format to successfully process the cancellation request.

200.description: The subscription has been successfully cancelled.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: A request body for canceling a subscription, represented as a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier of the result for the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the subscription after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message about the cancellation status or error, if any.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for successful subscription cancellation operation.
